content.comment_body: I've installed the demo of [product_name] [version_no], but every time I try to save a diagram, I get this error: Exception: java.lang.SecurityException: JCE cannot authenticate the provider BC. The logs indicate the problem relates to an unsigned JAR file (bcprov-jdk15to18-164.jar). Is there a solution for this? Thanks!
Is your Java installation updated to the latest version?
I'm running Java 8 update 351, which I installed today.
Try uninstalling the demo and reinstalling it. Which operating system are you using?

Recommended operating systems for [product_name] [version_no] include: Windows 7, 8, 10 (with Pentium IV CPU, 1 GB disk space, 512 MB RAM, SVGA at minimum 1024x768), Mac OS X 10.8 to 10.14, and Linux (tested with SUSE Linux 12 sp1, kernel 3.12.74); Java Runtime Environment 1.8.0_191 is the recommended version.
Unfortunately, none of these options are available to me currently. I recently recovered a [article_no] module and need to get it working. Is there any alternative software to [product_name]?
There isn't an alternative for creating programs for a [product_name]. Also, the demo version does not allow program transfer to or from a [product_name], only the full version does.

I'm aware of these restrictions; my aim was simply to work on the programming in the demo while searching for my original CDs, or before buying a new license. Is this software still receiving updates? Can I expect fixes in future releases? Thanks for your assistance!

Why wouldn't it continue to be updated? It's been mentioned that [company_name] is preparing to release [product_name] version [version_no] soon, and an updated LSC will follow. The current version is [version_no], available only as a download for licensed users.

Software for industrial devices tends to trail behind and is not generally optimized for Mac. There's hope that newer devices like IOT2000 will make improvements. This forum is supported by volunteer users who share their experience. If you need more, contact [company_name]'s support team using the Support Request link to communicate your needs. Good luck.
That may not be very helpful. Support typically points to compatibility details about which Mac OS versions each LSC release has been tested with. I've already listed this information.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are dealing with a critical problem running [product_name] [version_no] Demo on macOS 13, where saving diagrams causes a Java SecurityException due to unsigned JAR entries—likely from compatibility issues with newer macOS and Java runtimes. Users also mention demo feature limitations and have doubts about continued updates and product support.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the demo to work on current hardware and OS, particularly the ability to save locally. They hope for ongoing software updates and compatibility with newer systems, and would like basic programming features accessible while searching for a full license.
